item.description:
✨SKINTIFIC 10% Niacinamide Brightening Essence 50ML✨

What’s so special about this product?
Unlike any Niacinamide Serum, Skintific brightening serum is Formulated with “Royal DSM Niacinamide” that works differently than any other Niacinamide. Royal DSM Niacinamide can be found in well known brand such as SK-II. Royal DSM Niacinamide is the traditional version of Niacinamide that is more pure and have smaller molecules. Works more fast, Royal DSM Niacinamide can absorbs into the skin within 30 seconds and able to brighten the skin in 7 days while protecting the skin barrier
Alpha Arbutin also added to boost Royal DSM Niacinamide efficacy, making this serum works faster and into the deepest layer of skin
Still able to protect skin barrier with Ceramides and Hyaluronic Acid, this serum will keep the skin well moisturized
Safe for all skin type, because it also has Centella Asiatica that can help calms and soothe the skin

Size: 50ml
How to use
1. Before using moisturizer, put a few drops on clean face and neck.
2. For best results, please use it in the morning and evening.
3. In the morning, apply sunscreen.

================================
Hero Ingredients:

10% Royal DSM Niacinamide
Best kind of Niacinamide that works to brighten the skin, fade dark spot and hyperpigmentation, while even out the skin tone

Alpha Arbutin
Boost the Niacinamide efficacy, and works into the deepest layer of the skin preventing Melanin production

Ceramide
Repair and maintain skin barrier

Centella Asiatica
Works well to calm the skin, especially inflammation caused by acne or post acne scars

The benefits of choosing Skintific:
-Centella asiatica: soothes the skin
-7 days to fade dark spots (remove 100% of red acne scars, 50% of black acne scars)
-Alpha Arbutin: Helps niacinamide, brightens the complexion from within
-Ceramide: restores and strengthens the skin barrier while maintaining skin moisture.
-7 days to fade dark spots (remove 100% of red acne scars, 50% of black acne scars)
-The best niacinamide, from Royal DSM, like SK-II, can help overcome hyperpigmentation, rough skin, redness, and protect the skin barrier.

[Features]
Brightens the complexion and makes the skin radiant
Camouflage black spots
Disguise acne scars
Smooths and evens skin tone
Improve skin barrier
Oil control and moisturizing
Shrink pores

Full Ingredients:
AQUA, NIACINAMIDE, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, PEG/PPG-14/7 DIMETHYL ETHER, CENTELLA ASIATICA EXTRACT, GENTIANA SCABRA ROOT EXTRACT, AVENA SATIVA (OAT) KERNEL EXTRACT, YEAST EXTRACT, CROCUS SATIVUS FLOWER EXTRACT, ALPHA-ARBUTIN, CERAMIDE NP, AVENA SATIVA (OAT) KERNEL OIL, SPHINGOLIPIDS, CERAMIDE AS, CERAMIDE AP, CERAMIDE NS/CERAMIDE NG, 1,2-HEXANEDIOL, BIS-PEG-18 METHYL ETHER DIMETHYL SILANE, SODIUM POLYACRYLOYLDIMETHYL TAURATE, ALLANTOIN, HYDROGENATED LECITHIN, ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER, PENTYLENE GLYCOL, ISOHEXADECANE, TRANEXAMIC ACID, FRUCTOSE, AMINOMETHYL PROPANOL, PROPANEDIOL, SODIUM HYALURONATE, DIS
